summaries.en: This open-source course teaches AI engineering from fundamentals to deployment, covering LLMs, agents, computer vision, and MCP. It emphasizes building projects from scratch to deepen understanding of core concepts like attention mechanisms and agent architectures. Ideal for developers wanting hands-on experience, you can follow the structured curriculum to create your own AI applications or contribute to the community.
summaries.zh: 这是一个从零开始学习AI工程的开源课程，涵盖大语言模型、AI代理、计算机视觉和MCP等核心领域。其独特之处在于强调通过从零构建项目来深入理解注意力机制、代理架构等关键技术原理，而非仅使用现成库。课程设计循序渐进，适合希望扎实掌握AI工程实践的开发者。你可以按照结构化教程动手实现自己的AI应用，或参与社区贡献，将所学直接应用于实际项目。

summaries.en: OpenToonz is a full-featured open-source 2D animation software used by studios like Studio Ghibli. It offers professional tools for vector and raster drawing, frame-by-frame animation, and compositing. Technically, it uses a node-based workflow for effects and supports multi-plane camera setups. You can use it to create hand-drawn animations, integrate with other tools via its plugin system, or contribute to its development on GitHub.
summaries.zh: OpenToonz 是一款功能全面的开源 2D 动画制作软件，曾被吉卜力工作室等专业机构用于制作动画电影。它提供了矢量与位图绘制、逐帧动画、合成特效等专业工具，其核心技术亮点在于基于节点的特效工作流和多层摄像机系统，让动画师能灵活控制场景深度与视觉效果。你可以用它从零开始创作手绘动画，或通过插件系统集成到现有制作管线中。对于开发者，其 C++ 代码库是学习动画软件架构的绝佳范例，也欢迎贡献代码改进功能。

summaries.en: oh-my-pi is a terminal-based AI coding agent that streamlines code editing and task automation. Its key innovation is hash-anchored edits, ensuring precise, verifiable changes to files. It integrates LSP, Python, browser control, and subagents for complex workflows. Built with TypeScript and Rust, it supports multiple LLM providers like Claude and OpenAI. Developers can use it directly in the terminal to refactor code, run tests, or orchestrate multi-step development tasks, boosting productivity with reliable, AI-assisted automation.
summaries.zh: oh-my-pi 是一款终端 AI 编程代理，旨在简化代码编辑和任务自动化。其核心技术亮点是哈希锚定编辑，通过文件内容的哈希值精确锁定修改位置，确保每次变更可验证、可追溯，避免传统 AI 编辑中的错位问题。它集成了 LSP（语言服务器协议）、Python 解释器、浏览器控制和子代理机制，能处理复杂的多步骤开发流程。基于 TypeScript 和 Rust 构建，支持 Claude、OpenAI 等多种大模型。开发者可在终端中直接使用，完成代码重构、测试运行或编排自动化工作流，显著提升开发效率。

summaries.en: OpenWA is a free, open-source WhatsApp API gateway that lets you self-host your own WhatsApp integration. It provides a RESTful API to send and receive messages, manage contacts, and handle webhooks, giving you full control over your data and privacy. Technically, it uses a lightweight TypeScript stack and supports multiple WhatsApp instances. You can deploy it on your own server to build chatbots, automate customer support, or integrate WhatsApp into your business workflows without relying on third-party services.
summaries.zh: OpenWA 是一个免费开源的 WhatsApp API 网关，允许你自托管 WhatsApp 集成。它提供 RESTful API 来发送和接收消息、管理联系人以及处理 webhook，让你完全掌控数据和隐私。技术上，它采用轻量级 TypeScript 栈，支持多 WhatsApp 实例。你可以将其部署在自己的服务器上，用于构建聊天机器人、自动化客户支持，或将 WhatsApp 集成到业务工作流中，无需依赖第三方服务。

summaries.en: StreamBert is a cross-platform Electron desktop app that lets you stream or download movies, TV series, and anime from global sources without ads or tracking. Its technical strength lies in integrating multiple scrapers and streaming APIs into a unified, modern UI built with Electron and JavaScript. You can use it to browse, search, and play content instantly or queue downloads for offline viewing. Ideal for cord-cutters and anime fans who want a clean, private media hub.
summaries.zh: StreamBert 是一款跨平台的 Electron 桌面应用，让你无广告、无追踪地流媒体播放或下载全球的电影、电视剧和动漫。其技术亮点在于将多个爬虫和流媒体 API 集成到统一的现代化界面中，基于 Electron 和 JavaScript 构建。你可以用它浏览、搜索并即时播放内容，或排队下载以便离线观看。非常适合希望拥有干净、私密媒体中心的断线族和动漫爱好者。

summaries.en: files.md is a minimal, private app for managing Markdown files, designed as a distraction-free thinking space. It runs locally with no cloud dependencies, ensuring your notes stay private. Built in Go, it offers fast performance and simplicity. You can use it to organize personal notes, draft ideas, or maintain a local wiki. Its strength lies in being a quiet, focused tool for writers and thinkers who value privacy and simplicity over feature-rich complexity.
summaries.zh: files.md 是一个极简、私密的 Markdown 文件管理应用，旨在提供一个无干扰的思考空间。它完全本地运行，无云端依赖，确保笔记隐私。基于 Go 语言构建，性能快速且简单。你可以用它整理个人笔记、起草想法或维护本地维基。其优势在于为重视隐私和简洁性的写作者与思考者提供一个安静、专注的工具，而非功能繁杂的复杂系统。
